title: Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour Closes in Brussels — $467.5M Gross, 3.1M Tickets, Highest-Grossing Tour Ever by a Latin Artist
detail: Bad Bunny closes the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour with a final stadium show at King Baudouin Stadium in Brussels before roughly 50,000–56,000 fans (July 22, 2026), telling the crowd "I never thought we would close the tour in Belgium." Puerto Rican reggaetón pioneers Jowell & Randy make a surprise appearance during the 2.5-hour set, and Bad Bunny closes the show from atop the tour's recurring "casita" stage structure shouting "From Puerto Rico to the world." The 55-date tour — which launched November 21, 2025 in Santo Domingo and spanned the Americas, Asia, Oceania, and Europe — finishes having sold more than 3.1 million tickets and grossed approximately $467.5 million, the highest-grossing tour ever by a Latin artist. It marks Bad Bunny's 10th time atop Billboard's monthly Top Tours chart since the ranking launched in 2019, and pushes his career touring gross past the $1 billion mark set earlier in Barcelona.
